whereTheFieldIs: documentResult is published on the consolidated register read only (GET /api/v1/buildings/{id}/register?profile=consolidated&format=json, sources[].documentResult). The default register read the Studio already makes and the typed sources of the published ledger do not carry it; the ledger states it only as a sentence in missing[]. The Studio therefore makes one more GET per recorded building and joins the statement to its listed sources by source id. Types are derived from GetResponse of that route in @ulpin/api-client; no hand-written copy.
